summary: Frontend E2E testing of new Admin 'Catégories de livraison (Boutiques)' module + client /all-delivery branching. All flows pass.

tests_executed.name: Admin login via email/password
tests_executed.steps: Click 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' on phone login -> sheet 'Choisir un compte' -> click 'Email & mot de passe' -> fill admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! -> Se connecter -> lands on /admin

tests_executed.name: /admin/store-categories page renders 9 verticals in correct default order
tests_executed.result: PASS — 9 cards: food, grocery, medicine, flowers, stationery, wine, water, supermarket, construction. data-testid=admin-store-categories-page present.

tests_executed.name: Age badges (18+) on Médicaments & Vin admin cards
tests_executed.result: PASS — store-cat-age-badge-medicine and store-cat-age-badge-wine both rendered with '18+'.

tests_executed.name: Vehicle badges present on all 9 cards
tests_executed.result: PASS — store-cat-vehicle-badge-{key} = 9/9 (Construction shows 'Voiture / Fourgon', others 'Tous véhicules' by default).

tests_executed.name: Toggle category Active/Inactive (Papeterie/stationery)
tests_executed.steps: click store-cat-toggle-stationery -> pill flips to 'Inactif', toggle visual switches.
tests_executed.result: PASS — pill state changed Actif -> Inactif and back.

tests_executed.name: Edit modal flow (grocery)
tests_executed.steps: Open store-cat-edit-grocery modal (store-cat-edit-modal visible) -> change store-cat-edit-name to 'Livraison Courses TEST' -> age/vehicle selects render -> save via store-cat-edit-save -> card name updated.

tests_executed.name: Reorder via up/down arrows
tests_executed.steps: store-cat-down-grocery moves grocery from index 1 to 2 -> order now [food, medicine, grocery,...]; store-cat-up-grocery restores order.

tests_executed.name: Client /all-delivery hides inactive categories
tests_executed.steps: Logged in as a fresh regular user (registered via /api/auth/register testuser@test.sb). With stationery disabled, /all-delivery showed 8 tiles (stationery hidden). Re-enabled stationery and reload showed all 9 tiles.

tests_executed.name: Client age badges (delivery-age-medicine, delivery-age-wine)
tests_executed.result: PASS — both show '18+' badge on tile.

tests_executed.name: Cleanup / restore default state
tests_executed.result: DONE — stationery re-enabled, grocery name restored to 'Livraison Courses', default order [food,grocery,medicine,flowers,stationery,wine,water,supermarket,construction] confirmed.

observations: Admin users are redirected away from /all-delivery (page.goto('/all-delivery') while logged in as admin lands on /admin). This is expected since /all-delivery is a client (mobile) route. Tested correctly using a regular user account.

Unauthenticated visit to /all-delivery redirects to the marketing homepage '/'. So the route requires auth (user role) — confirm this matches PRD; the brief did say 'When logged in as a regular user'.
Default delivery_vehicle for Construction is 'car' (Voiture / Fourgon); others default to 'any' (Tous véhicules). Age=18+ is pre-seeded on Médicaments and Vin.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminStoreCategories.js — pill status DOM is the first <span> in the header row; tests must select '[data-testid=store-cat-card-{key}] span:has-text("Actif"|"Inactif")' to avoid grabbing the emoji icon. Consider adding data-testid='store-cat-status-{key}' to the pill for robust automation.
AllDeliveryPage.js — no auth guard inside the component itself, but the route is protected at the router level. Confirm the route guard intent (regular user only).

EditStoreCategoryModal closes when clicking the dark overlay (onClick={onClose}) — this is OK because the inner div stopPropagation, but a misclick on the backdrop loses unsaved edits silently. Consider a confirm-on-dirty.
test_credentials: admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! (email path via 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion'); user used: dynamically registered testuser{ts}@test.sb / TestPass123!
seed_data_creation: Registered a throwaway regular user (testuser{ts}@test.sb) to exercise /all-delivery as a 'user' role. No category data changes left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow for admin: click 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' on /login -> bottom sheet -> 'Email & mot de passe' -> fill -> submit. /all-delivery requires a 'user' role; admins get redirected to /admin and anons to '/'. Categories REST API: GET /api/store-categories (public), admin under /api/admin/store-categories (toggle, reorder, update). All 9 keys: food, grocery, medicine, flowers, stationery, wine, water, supermarket, construction.
